{{Infobox auto}}

'''Stroganoff''' is a beef and mushroom dish that heals {{Hp|16}}, tied with [[gnocchi]] for the most healing of any crafted meal. It has no effect. Replacing its [[braised mushroom]] with a toadstool or fungus makes one of three variants with an effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/stroganoff.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[braised mushroom]], a [[steak]], dough, a [[milk bottle]] and a [[bowl]]. Obtaining a braised mushroom unlocks the recipe. The milk bottle's glass bottle isn't returned.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating stroganoff takes 1.8 seconds and heals {{Hp|16}}. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
